question: With a free WeatherAPI.com key: what is the per-minute burst limit of the Free plan, and what status, body and headers does a call over it answer?
why: No page read gives a Free-plan number or a burst answer: the terms name a per-minute burst limit and point to the pricing page, whose plan table has no rate-limit row; the error table lists no burst code and the OpenAPI file documents 400, 401 and 403 responses only; one blog post names a per-second ceiling by plan and HTTP 429, another says free plans have burst limits with an unclear error, and a tutorial's code comment says 1000 requests per hour for the free tier. Measuring it needs a key from a sign-up (email and password, or Google). A new account runs on the 7-day Business trial first, so a burst sent in the first 7 days would read the Business plan's limit.
